pages.label: Recipe: Vanilla sponge
pages.html:
Vanilla sponge cake

EASY · 55 MIN

A light, even sponge that holds frosting and fruit. One bowl, five ingredients, no creaming marathon.

Ingredients · 20 cm round

  • Butter, soft150 g
  • Caster sugar150 g
  • Eggs3
  • Self-raising flour150 g
  • Milk2 tbsp
  • Vanilla extract2 tsp

Different pan?

  1. Heat the oven to 170°C fan. Grease and line a 20 cm round tin.
  2. Beat butter and sugar for 3 minutes until pale. Add eggs one at a time, with a spoon of flour each.
  3. Fold in the rest of the flour, milk and vanilla until just combined.
  4. Bake 28–32 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 10 minutes.

pages.label: Why did it sink?
pages.html:
Home/Why did it sink?

Why did it sink?

Eight things that go wrong, and what to change.

My cake sank in the middle

The oven door opened too early, or the oven ran cold. Wait until the last 5 minutes before checking, and use an oven thermometer.

Cookies spread into one sheet

Butter too warm or too little flour. Chill the dough for 30 minutes and weigh the flour.

Tart base shrank

Rest the dough in the tin for 30 minutes before blind-baking, and don't stretch it.

Dense, heavy crumb

Over-mixing after adding flour, or old baking powder. Fold gently; test the powder in hot water.

pages.html:
Home/FAQ

FAQ

Why grams and not cups?

Cups vary by up to 30%. Grams are the same every time.

Can I swap butter for oil?

In cakes, yes, but the crumb changes. We note it on each recipe.

Do I need a stand mixer?

No recipe here requires one.
